Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Weekly budget allocation, priority debts, To Buy categories and items, goals, and saved QRPh snapshots for a named workspace (e.g. Demo 'von') without PII or password fields.

workspaceId.description: Canonical workspace identifier matching the document ID.

updatedByDevice.description: Ephemeral device session identifier that performed the latest write.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded at workspace creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp recorded on each workspace update.

budgetState.description: Native structured map containing banks, fixedItems, variableCategories, debts, goals, toBuyCategories, toBuyItems, savedAllocations, and activityLog.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Named budget workspace (such as Demo 'von') synced directly via Firestore without Google Sign-In popup; zero PII stored.
